callouts.text: Light-pipe aim line and aim point: always drawn -> only with the 'Light beam' layer; it was a second dashed line ending on the retina next to the drop line but meaning 'illuminated centre', not 'landing point'
In-scene label 0.36 -> 0.3 mm (one decimal, rounded down like the panel)
Critical tip markers: 1.5x radius plus a light back-face outline in both views. Perceptible non-hue separation is scope only; the ≈2 px Overview marker remains too small to rely on it.
